title: 受験応援
subject_en: Exam-support scenes and objects in a relaxed hand-drawn style: each a small complete object or scene, warm and encouraging, simple-faced people Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 合格祈願のお守り・絵馬・鉛筆・夜食・目覚まし時計など、受験生を応援する場面12点の素材です。応援メッセージのカードや塾の案内に使えます。
items: a shrine amulet pouch with a gold cord
a wooden votive plaque with a cherry blossom drawn on it, hanging from a cord
three sharpened pencils with erasers tied with a ribbon
a student's desk at night with a bowl of noodles and a lamp
an alarm clock ringing beside a pile of textbooks
a student with a headband studying hard at a desk
a branch with cherry blossom buds about to open
a parent handing a lunch box to a student at a front door
a student with a bag walking to a school gate in winter coat and scarf
a student and parent happily looking at a pinned list on a board, numbers blank
a stack of reference books and a notebook with a bookmark
a red daruma doll with one eye filled in
